name: artcraft_generate_audio
description: Generate music, remix audio, or synthesize sound effects using ArtCraft's OmniGen Audio API. Supports Suno Music, Suno Remix, Suno Sounds, Suno Sample, and Seed Audio 1.0.

prompt.description: Lyrics or text prompt for the audio generation

audio_media_tokens.description: Reference audio or remix source media tokens

image_media_tokens.description: Optional reference image for image-to-audio (Seed Audio)

keep_lyrics.description: Whether to retain original lyrics (Suno Remix)

is_instrumental.description: Whether to generate instrumental music without vocals

is_loopable.description: Whether sound effect should cleanly loop (Suno Sounds)

pitch.description: Pitch shift in semitones -12 to 12 (Seed Audio)
